versions.content: When calling CanIf_Transmit() for an FC on a generic connection (N - PDU with MetaData), the C anTp module shall provide the stored addressing information via the MetaData of the N - PDU. The addressing information in the MetaData depends on the addressing format:  Normal, Extended, Mixed 11 bit: none  Normal fixed, Mixed 29 bit: N_SA (saved N_TA), N_TA (saved N_SA)
